title: What drives the long-term relationship between economic development and environmental quality? The role of spatial dispersion vs. agglomeration
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The dramatic improvement in air quality in major Chinese cities in recent years has led to renewed interest in the question of whether economic development allows a country to “grow” out of its environmental problems. We shed new light on this question by identifying a new factor that can drive the long-term relationship between economic development and environmental quality , namely, a spatial effect that arises from a tradeoff between environmental quality and agglomeration economies . We show theoretically that this spatial effect can lead to an inverted U-shaped relationship between income and pollution, i.e., an environmental Kuznets curve . In addition, we decompose changes in US air pollution concentrations from 1990 to 2017 to allow for a possible spatial effect. Results point to the potential importance of a spatial effect in explaining the reductions in carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations. However, little of the change in sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) concentrations in the US can be attributed to a potential spatial effect.
abstract_zh: 近年来中国主要城市空气质量的显著改善，重新引发了人们对经济发展能否使一国“增长”出环境问题的兴趣。我们通过识别一个能够驱动经济发展与环境质量长期关系的新因素，为这一问题提供了新的见解，即由环境质量与集聚经济之间的权衡所产生的空间效应。我们从理论上表明，这种空间效应可能导致收入与污染之间呈倒U形关系，即环境库兹涅茨曲线。此外，我们分解了1990年至2017年美国空气污染浓度的变化，以考虑可能存在的空间效应。结果表明，空间效应可能在解释一氧化碳（CO）浓度的下降方面具有重要作用。然而，美国二氧化硫（SO2）浓度的变化中，很少能归因于潜在的空间效应。

title: The impact of industrial sulfur dioxide emissions regulation on agricultural production in China
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Is Environmental Regulation the Answer to Pollution Problems in Urbanizing Economies?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper seeks to better understand the persistent environmental problems in urbanizing economies. We examine the effectiveness of environmental policy in an economy with agglomeration economies and endogenous firm relocation and entry/exit. We show that, although environmental regulation is effective in the short run, for economies that are urbanizing and characterized by partial agglomeration it may instead exacerbate pollution problems once endogenous firm relocation/entry/exit occurs. We present initial empirical evidence in the context of water pollution in China that demonstrates the importance of agglomeration economies in determining the impacts of environmental regulation.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在更好地理解城市化经济体中持续存在的环境问题。我们考察了在存在集聚经济以及内生的企业迁入与进入/退出的经济体中，环境政策的有效性。我们表明，尽管环境监管在短期内是有效的，但对于处于城市化进程中、具有部分集聚特征的经济体而言，一旦内生的企业迁入、进入与退出发生，环境监管反而可能加剧污染问题。我们以中国水污染为背景提供了初步的实证证据，表明集聚经济在决定环境监管影响方面具有重要作用。

title: Negative Emotions Increase Unhealthy Eating: Evidence from the Wuhan Lockdown during COVID-19
Open Space in U.S. Urban Areas: Where Might There Be Too Much or Too Little of a Good Thing?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Rapidly Growing Subsidization of Crop Insurance in Europe Ignores Potential Environmental Effects
Impacts of Climate and Weather on Irrigation Technology Adoption and Agricultural Water Use in the US Pacific Northwest
abstract: In this article, we model long‐run responses to climate expectations that are predetermined before the growing season and short‐run responses to weather realizations during the growing season. The model is applied to a climatically diverse region, the U.S. Pacific Northwest, and the most comprehensive dataset on irrigation in the United States to estimate the impact of extreme weather on irrigation technology adoption and agricultural water use. Impacts on agricultural water use were driven more by adjustments to irrigated acreage (extensive margin effects) than by adjustments to the water application rate (intensive margin effects). The model captures the two mechanisms for irrigation to mitigate freeze damage to crops: wetting the soil (heat retention) and over‐head sprinkler irrigation (latent heat). Realized late spring freeze caused water use for orchard/vineyard to increase by 3%, but this represents less than a 1% increase in total agricultural water use. Expected spring freeze variability encouraged adoption of sprinkler irrigation technology for some crops.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个模型，刻画了生长季前已确定的气候预期所引发的长期反应，以及生长季内天气实现值所引发的短期反应。该模型应用于气候多样的美国太平洋西北地区，并利用美国迄今最为全面的灌溉数据集，估计极端天气对灌溉技术采用及农业用水的影响。农业用水的影响更多源于灌溉面积的调整（外延边际效应），而非灌溉用水量的调整（集约边际效应）。实际发生的晚春霜冻使果园和葡萄园的用水量增加了3%，但这仅占农业总用水量增幅的不到1%。该模型刻画了灌溉减轻作物冻害的两种机制：湿润土壤（保温）和喷灌（潜热）。预期中的春季霜冻变异性促使部分作物采用喷灌技术。

title: Preemptive Incentives and Liability Rules for Wildfire Risk Management
abstract: Wildfires in the U.S. are growing in extent and severity, causing billions of dollars in damage each year. Wildfire policy has increased its focus on integrating fire suppression with risk mitigation through fuel reduction. In this context incentives to elicit management activities that mitigate fire risk are critical, because landowners may not carry out sufficient risk mitigation on their own. We examine the effectiveness and welfare implications of several incentive policies, including two novel approaches not studied in the context of wildfire management: liability rules and voluntary agreements. Our analysis uses a threshold model of public good provision, which allows for each landowner's mitigation choices to depend on the total amount of mitigation in the landscape. Our results suggest that the risk mitigation threshold is critical in determining the effectiveness and welfare effects of different incentive programs. When the threshold is high, only voluntary agreements and cost sharing can increase mitigation effort and welfare. Negligence standards can also be effective and welfare enhancing but only when the mitigation threshold is sufficiently low.
abstract_zh: 美国的野火范围日益扩大、严重程度日益加剧，每年造成数十亿美元的损失。野火政策日益关注将灭火与通过燃料削减来降低风险相结合。在这一背景下，激励土地所有者采取减缓火灾风险的管理活动至关重要，因为土地所有者自身可能不会进行充分的风险缓解。我们考察了若干激励政策的有效性及福利影响，其中包括两种在野火管理中尚未被研究过的新颖方法：责任规则和自愿协议。我们的分析采用公共物品供给的阈值模型，该模型允许每位土地所有者的缓解选择取决于整个景观中缓解的总量。我们的结果表明，风险缓解阈值对于决定不同激励计划的有效性及福利效应至关重要。当阈值较高时，只有自愿协议和成本分摊才能提高缓解努力和福利。过失标准在阈值足够低时，也可能有效且提高福利。

title: Assessing Effects of Federal Crop Insurance Supply on Acreage and Yield of Specialty Crops
abstract: Crop insurance may affect harvested acreage and yield by influencing producers’ behavior such as land allocation and input use. Although specialty crops are a major source of farm income, especially on the U.S. west coast, they have not received as much attention as field crops in previous empirical studies. This paper assesses the effect of moral hazard and adverse selection associated with the federal crop insurance program (FCIP) on the acreage and yield of major specialty crops in California. An econometric method that expands the switching regression model is developed to assess the effect. Results suggest that federal crop insurance can change specialty crop growers’ production responses to climate and soil conditions. The moral hazard effect tends to increase the acreage and yield of the specialty crops, whereas the adverse selection effect tends to have the opposite effect. The overall effect of the FCIP on acreage and yield of specialty crops is found to be moderate.
abstract_zh: 作物保险可能通过影响生产者的土地配置和投入使用等行为，进而影响收获面积和单产。尽管特色作物是农场收入的主要来源，尤其是在美国西海岸，但与大田作物相比，以往的实证研究对其关注较少。本文评估了联邦作物保险计划（FCIP）所伴随的道德风险与逆向选择对加利福尼亚州主要特色作物面积和单产的影响。我们发展了一种扩展的转换回归模型的计量方法来进行评估。结果表明，联邦作物保险能够改变特色作物种植者对气候和土壤条件的生产反应。道德风险效应倾向于增加特色作物的面积和单产，而逆向选择效应则倾向于产生相反的作用。研究发现，FCIP对特色作物面积和单产的总体影响为中等程度。

title: Agglomeration: Economic and Environmental Impacts
abstract: Urbanization is taking place at an unprecedented pace and scale in China, India, and many other emerging economies. This will have profound impacts on the world economy and environment. This review provides a critical assessment of the current understanding of the intertwined relationships between agglomeration, economic growth, and environmental quality. We start by providing a brief overview of the extensive literature on the drivers of agglomeration and its economic impact. We then discuss the opposing views on the environmental impact of agglomeration and illustrate the trade-offs involved when choosing among different levels and forms of agglomeration. Finally, we discuss challenges for environmental management in a rapidly urbanizing economy and some lessons learned from history and experiences of urban development and their policy implications. The review concludes with a discussion of key knowledge gaps and future research directions.
abstract_zh: 城市化正以前所未有的速度和规模在中国、印度及其他新兴经济体推进，这将对世界经济和环境产生深远影响。本文对当前关于集聚、经济增长与环境质量之间错综复杂关系的理解进行了批判性评估。我们首先简要概述了关于集聚驱动因素及其经济影响的大量文献。随后，我们讨论了关于集聚环境影响的不同观点，并阐明了在选择不同程度和形式的集聚时所涉及的权衡取舍。最后，我们探讨了快速城市化经济体中环境管理面临的挑战，以及从城市发展历史与经验中汲取的教训及其政策含义。综述最后讨论了关键的知识空白与未来研究方向。

title: Energy Price Shocks, Household Location Patterns, and Housing Crises: Theory and Implications
Environmental Regulation, Emissions and Productivity: Evidence from Chinese COD-emitting Manufacturers
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Spatial Distribution of Natural Reserves in China: Driving Forces in the Past and Conservation Challenges in the Future
Urbanization and Agricultural Productivity: Some Lessons from European Cities
abstract: This article evaluates the effect of increasing urbanization on agricultural productivity at the rural-urban fringe for a set of European metropolises. It takes into account changes in total developed area, population density and the level of urban fragmentation associated with urbanization. To cope with endogeneity issues related to urban equilibrium covariates, we set up an instrumental variables strategy based on historical and institutional instruments. Our results indicate that increasing population density increases agricultural productivity at the rural-urban fringe, while increasing urban fragmentation may have a detrimental effect on agricultural productivity at low levels of fragmentation. We use instrumental variable Bayesian model averaging (IVBMA) to address model uncertainty and use an alternative panel dataset to confirm our instrumental strategy. Our results are robust to alternative model specifications and estimation methods.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了欧洲若干大都市城乡结合部中，城市化进程加快对农业生产率的影响。文章考虑了城市化过程中总开发面积、人口密度以及城市破碎化程度的变化。为应对城市均衡协变量带来的内生性问题，我们构建了一个基于历史和制度工具变量的策略。研究结果表明，人口密度的增加会提高城乡结合部的农业生产率，而城市破碎化程度的加剧在破碎化水平较低时可能对农业生产率产生不利影响。我们采用工具变量贝叶斯模型平均（IVBMA）方法来处理模型不确定性，并利用另一套面板数据确认我们的工具变量策略。研究结果对于不同的模型设定和估计方法均保持稳健。

title: Efficiency-Equity Tradeoffs in Targeting Payments for Ecosystem Services
Impacts of Federal Crop Insurance on Land Use and Environmental Quality
abstract: This article integrates economic and biophysical models to assess how federal crop revenue insurance programs affect land use, cropping systems, and environmental quality in the U.S. Corn Belt region. The empirical framework includes econometric models that predict land conversion and crop choices at the parcel level based on expectation and variance of crop revenues, land quality, climate conditions, and physical characteristics at each site. The predictions are then combined with site‐specific environmental production functions to determine the effect of revenue insurance on nitrate runoff and leaching, soil water and wind erosion, and carbon sequestration. Results suggest that federal crop insurance has, on average, a small effect on conversions of non‐cropland to cropland, and somewhat more significant impacts on crop choice and crop rotation. These changes in cropping systems have, on average, small impacts on agricultural pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文整合了经济模型和生物物理模型，以评估联邦农作物收入保险计划如何影响美国玉米带地区的土地利用、种植制度和环境质量。实证框架包括计量经济模型，该模型基于作物收入的期望和方差、土地质量、气候条件以及每个地块的物理特征，在地块层面预测土地转换和作物选择。随后，这些预测与地块特定的环境生产函数相结合，以确定收入保险对硝酸盐径流与淋溶、土壤水蚀和风蚀以及碳封存的影响。结果表明，联邦农作物保险平均而言对非耕地向耕地的转换影响较小，但对作物选择和轮作的影响则较为显著。这些种植制度的变化平均而言对农业污染的影响较小。

title: Rural-Urban Interdependency: A Framework Integrating Regional, Urban and Environmental Economic Insights
Threshold, Pervasive Incentives, and Preemptive Conservation of Endangered Species
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Agglomeration, Congestion, and Regional Disparities in U.S. Employment Growth
abstract: Wide regional disparities exist in U.S. employment growth. To identify the causes of this disparities, we assess the relative contribution of locational characteristics to regional employment growth in the United States from 2001 to 2010 by estimating an employment growth model with the spatial‐lag effect. Results show that, at the margin, congestion effects dominate localized scale externalities in urban counties. A diverse industrial structure and rich human capital are the main factors that contribute to regional disparities in employment growth. Significant spatial‐lag effects indicate that spatial targeting and regional coordination are necessary to maximize the effectiveness of employment growth policies.
abstract_zh: 美国的就业增长存在显著的地区差异。为识别这种差异的成因，我们利用包含空间滞后效应的就业增长模型，评估了2001至2010年间区位特征对美国各地区就业增长的相对贡献。结果显示，在城市县中，拥堵效应在边际上超过了局部规模外部性。多元化的产业结构与丰富的人力资本是造成地区就业增长差异的主要因素。显著的空间滞后效应表明，需要进行空间瞄准和区域协调，以最大限度地提高就业增长政策的有效性。

title: How Does Urbanization Affect the Economy and the Environment? Policy Challenges and Research Needs
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Urbanization is arguably one of the most pervasive socioeconomic forces affecting economic development, ecosystem health, and human well-being. This paper analyzes the interaction between urbanization, economic development, and environmental quality and provides an overview of the literature on the interaction. We argue that the complex roles of urbanization in the economic and ecological systems necessitate a new policy approach to urbanization management. This paper also provides a brief overview of land use policies at local, regional and national levels in the European Union and the United States and discusses policy options for urbanization management. It concludes with a brief discussion of policy challenges and research needs for efficient urbanization management.
abstract_zh: 城市化可以说是影响经济发展、生态系统健康和人类福祉的最普遍的社会经济力量之一。本文分析了城市化、经济发展与环境质量之间的相互作用，并概述了该主题的相关文献。我们认为，城市化在经济与生态系统中所扮演的复杂角色，要求采用新的政策方法来管理城市化。本文还简要概述了欧盟和美国在地方、区域和国家层面的土地利用政策，并讨论了城市化管理的政策选择。最后，本文简要讨论了高效城市化管理所面临的政策挑战和研究需求。

title: Impacts of Climate Change on Land-Use and Wetland Productivity in the Prairie Pothole Region of North America
Irrigation Decisions for Major West Coast Crops: Water Scarcity and Climate Determinants
Land Use Change and Soil Carbon Sequestration in China: Where Does It Pay to Conserve?
Optimal Location, Size and Budget of Open Space Conservation
venue: Journal of Real Estate Finance and Economics

title: Pollution Mobility, Productivity Disparity, and the Spatial Distribution of Polluting and Nonpolluting Firms
abstract: This paper first develops a model to characterize the equilibrium distribution of polluting and nonpolluting firms and then turns to the larger question of whether the equilibrium distribution is socially optimal. We find that the equilibrium distribution of polluting firms differs from the social optimum when they generate a large amount of stationary pollution and have much higher or lower productivity than clean firms. In these cases, conventional pollution control approaches generally do not bring about an optimal distribution. Consideration of transport costs along with productivity and pollution changes some of the classic results of the new economic geography literature.
abstract_zh: 本文首先建立了一个模型，刻画污染企业与非污染企业的均衡分布，进而探讨该均衡分布是否具有社会最优性这一更大的问题。我们发现，当污染企业产生大量持续性污染，且其生产率远高于或远低于清洁企业时，污染企业的均衡分布会偏离社会最优。在这些情形下，传统的污染控制方法通常无法带来最优分布。考虑运输成本以及生产率和污染的变化后，一些新经济地理学文献中的经典结论发生了改变。

title: The Evolution of Municipal Structure
The Price and Welfare Effects of Biofuel Mandates and Subsidies
Land-Use Patterns and Spatially Dependent Ecosystem Services: Some Microeconomic Foundations
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This paper develops and reviews some microeconomic foundations for the provision of spatially-dependent ecosystem services from land. We focus on ecosystem services described by a production function with spatial dependencies in the primary input — the amount and pattern of land in particular uses and management. Many ecosystem service production functions are affected by spatial dependences, particularly those involving fish, wildlife, and water quality. We illustrate the various sources of demand for ecosystem services and then provide a novel development of the effects of alternative spatial dependencies on the shape of the supply curve for ecosystem services. Our analysis emphasizes that the optimal supply curve requires a mechanism to coordinate landowners’ decisions and internalize the input externalities that arise from production functions being spatially dependent. Finally, we use our framework to illustrate and review some key implications for linking demand and supply for policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文发展并综述了土地提供空间依赖性生态系统服务的一些微观经济学基础。我们关注的生态系统服务由一个在主要投入——土地的数量与格局及其特定用途和管理——中存在空间依赖性的生产函数描述。许多生态系统服务生产函数都受到空间依赖性的影响，尤其是涉及鱼类、野生动物和水质的服务。我们阐明了生态系统服务需求的各种来源，随后对不同空间依赖性如何影响生态系统服务供给曲线的形状进行了新颖的推导。我们的分析强调，最优供给曲线需要一种机制来协调土地所有者的决策，并将因生产函数存在空间依赖性而产生的投入外部性内部化。最后，我们运用该框架阐释并综述了将需求与供给联系起来以进行政策设计的若干关键含义。

title: Public Open Space Conservation under a Budget Constraint
Identifying Drivers of Land Use Change in China: A Spatial Multinomial Logit Model Analysis
abstract: This paper presents an empirical analysis of major drivers of land use change in China from 1988 to 2005. We compile a geographic information system database and develop a new method to estimate an econometric land use model that explicitly takes into account the spatial interactions between land use decisions. Results indicate that increasing urban land value was a major driver of farmland development, while rising rural income was a primary driver of conversion of farmland to forests and grassland. The growth of urban income and road density reduces grassland conversion but increases deforestation. (JEL Q15, R14)
abstract_zh: 本文对1988至2005年中国土地利用变化的主要驱动因素进行了实证分析。我们编制了一个地理信息系统数据库，并提出了一种新方法来估计计量土地利用模型，该模型明确考虑了土地利用决策之间的空间相互作用。结果表明，城市土地价值的上升是耕地开发的主要驱动力，而农村收入的增长则是耕地转为林地和草地的主要驱动力。城市收入增长和道路密度的提高减少了草地转换，但增加了毁林。（JEL Q15, R14）

title: The Cost of Land Use Regulation versus the Value of Individual Exemption: Oregon's Measures 37 and 49
Heterogeneous Firms, Trade Liberalization and Agglomeration
Locational Amenities, Increasing Returns, and Urban Development
Urbanization and the Viability of Local Agricultural Economies
abstract: Urbanization presents both opportunities and challenges for farmers and farm-supporting sectors on the urban fringe. This paper examines the effects of urbanization on the viability of input suppliers and output processors and on the cost and profitability of farming. An analytical model is developed to provide insights into such effects. This model motivates a multiple-equation empirical model that we estimate using county-level panel data for California, Idaho, Oregon, and Washington. Results provide evidence that urbanization has a significant impact on agricultural infrastructure, farm production costs, and net farm income and suggest that agriculture-related opportunities of urbanization outweigh the challenges. (JEL O18)
abstract_zh: 城市化为城市边缘地区的农民和农业相关部门既带来了机遇，也带来了挑战。本文考察了城市化对投入品供应商和产出加工商的生存能力，以及对农业生产成本和盈利能力的影响。我们建立了一个分析模型以深入理解这些影响。该模型引出了一个多方程实证模型，我们利用加利福尼亚州、爱达荷州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州的县级面板数据对其进行了估计。结果表明，城市化对农业基础设施、农业生产成本以及农场净收入具有显著影响，并表明与城市化相关的农业机遇超过了挑战。（JEL O18）

title: Economic Fundamentals and Urban-Suburban Disparities
The Effect of the Conservation Reserve Program on Land Values
abstract: This paper evaluates the effects of the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) on land values. A theoretical model is presented to analyze the interaction between farmers' CRP participation decisions and land values. Empirical models are estimated to evaluate the effects of the CRP on land values. Results suggest that CRP participation had the largest effects in the Mountain, Southern Plains, and Northern Plains regions, where it increased average farmland values by 5% to 14%, 4% to 6%, and 2% to 5%, respectively. The CRP also had a statistically significant effect on developed land values, but the percentage increases were smaller. Implications of the results for the design of conservation programs are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了保护性休耕计划（CRP）对土地价值的影响。文章提出了一个理论模型，以分析农民参与CRP的决策与土地价值之间的相互作用。我们估计了实证模型，以评估CRP对土地价值的影响。结果表明，CRP参与在山地、南部平原和北部平原地区的影响最大，分别使平均农田价值提高了5%至14%、4%至6%和2%至5%。CRP对开发用地价值也有统计上显著的影响，但百分比增幅较小。本文讨论了研究结果对保护计划设计的启示。

title: Firms' Motivations for Environmental Overcompliance
abstract: This article examines firms motivations for environmental overcompliance. A theoretical model is developed to identify the internal and external factors that influence firms decisions for environmental overcompliance. An empirical analysis is then conducted to determine the statistical significance of those factors using the primary data collected in an industrial survey in Oregon. The results suggest that diverse factors influence business decisions for environmental overcompliance, including market forces, regulatory pressures, and personal values and beliefs of upper management toward environmental stewardship.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业自愿超额遵守环境法规（环境超额合规）的动机。我们建立了一个理论模型，以识别影响企业做出环境超额合规决策的内部与外部因素。随后，利用俄勒冈州一项工业调查所收集的原始数据，我们进行了实证分析，以检验这些因素的统计显著性。结果表明，多种因素影响着企业的环境超额合规决策，包括市场力量、监管压力，以及高层管理者对环境管理的个人价值观与信念。

title: Targeting Incentives to Reduce Habitat Fragmentation
The Economics of Urban-Rural Space
Optimal Land Development with Endogenous Environmental Amenities
abstract: A spatially explicit model of the optimal timing and location of land development is presented that incorporates dynamic interactions between land development and water quality. Ignoring two‐way interactions leads to a lower level of water quality, more development, and lower social welfare. The optimal pace and pattern of development can be achieved through the assessment of an impact fee that internalizes pollution damages and irreversibility costs. Our results demonstrate the importance of accounting for the spatial dimension of land use, the interdependence between land use and environmental quality, and development irreversibility in models of urbanization and amenity‐driven growth.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个空间显式模型，用以刻画土地开发的最优时机与位置，该模型纳入了土地开发与水质之间的动态相互作用。忽略双向相互作用会导致水质水平较低、开发过度以及社会福利下降。通过征收将污染损害和不可逆成本内部化的开发影响费，可以实现开发的最优速度与格局。我们的结果表明，在城市化和由环境舒适度驱动的增长模型中，必须考虑土地利用的空间维度、土地利用与环境质量之间的相互依存关系，以及开发的不可逆性。

title: Protecting Watershed Ecosystems through Targeted Local Land Use Policies
abstract: Land use change is the most pervasive force driving the degradation of watershed ecosystems. This article combines an econometric model of land use choice with models of watershed health indicators to examine the effects of land use policies on watershed ecosystems through their effect on land use. Our results suggest that incentive‐based land use policies and property acquisition programs can have relatively large positive impacts on watershed health, while policies that change the returns to land use are less effective. The results suggest that there is potential for targeting these policies because their impacts vary across watersheds with different land use mixes.
abstract_zh: 土地利用变化是导致流域生态系统退化的最普遍力量。本文将土地利用选择的计量模型与流域健康指标模型相结合，考察了土地利用政策通过影响土地利用而对流域生态系统产生的效应。我们的结果表明，基于激励的土地利用政策和财产收购计划，可以对流域健康产生相对较大的正面影响，而改变土地利用回报的政策则效果较差。结果表明，这些政策的目标定位具有潜力，因为其影响在具有不同土地利用构成的流域之间存在差异。

title: The Economics of Environmental Management in a Spatially Heterogeneous River Basin
abstract: This article examines the allocative efficiency of water quality management activities to protect endangered salmonid species in a heterogeneous watershed in the Pacific Northwest. Using an integrated hydrological, biological, and economic modeling framework, the relative efficiency of alternative policy targets such as temperature reductions and enhanced fish populations is investigated. Results indicate that the heterogeneous nature of riparian conditions and stream morphology influence the choice of management activities. Localized effects of management efforts on temperature are important to achieve small temperature reductions. However, as the desired magnitude of temperature reductions increases, the cumulative (longitudinal) effects become more important, and management efforts in more distant reaches are more efficient than efforts nearer the point of monitoring. Finally, if the underlying objective is to increase fish populations, targeting conservation efforts based on physical criteria such as water temperatures or other total maximum daily load regulations may lead to substantial inefficiencies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在太平洋西北地区一个异质性流域中，为保护濒危鲑鳟鱼类而进行的水质管理活动的配置效率。利用综合水文、生物与经济建模框架，我们考察了不同政策目标（例如降低水温和增加鱼类种群数量）的相对效率。结果表明，河岸条件和河流形态的异质性会影响管理活动的选择。对于较小幅度的水温降低，管理措施的局部效应十分重要。然而，随着期望的水温降幅增大，累积（沿河流纵向）效应变得更加重要，此时离监测点较远河段的管理努力比靠近监测点的努力更为有效。最后，如果潜在目标是增加鱼类种群，那么以水温或其他总日最大负荷（TMDL）规定等物理标准为依据来瞄准保护努力，可能会导致严重的低效。

title: Spatial Heterogeneity and the Choice of Instruments to Control Nonpoint Pollution
Cumulative Effects and Optimal Targeting of Conservation Efforts: Steelhead Trout Habitat Enhancement in Oregon
abstract: A major problem with some conservation programs is that they ignore potential cumulative (threshold) effects in environmental quality management. The objective of this study is to investigate the importance of cumulative effects in the targeting of conservation efforts. The empirical focus is on habitat investments to protect an important anadromous fish species in the Pacific Northwest, steelhead trout. Results of the analysis point to a substantial cumulative effect in the relationship between water quality and abundance in this fishery, which affects the efficiency of specific habitat investments.
abstract_zh: 一些保护项目的主要问题在于，它们忽视了环境质量管理中潜在的累积（阈值）效应。本研究的目的是探讨累积效应在保护努力瞄准中的重要性。实证研究聚焦于为保护太平洋西北地区一种重要溯河洄游鱼类——虹鳟（钢头鳟）——而进行的栖息地投资。分析结果表明，该渔业中水质与种群丰度之间的关系存在显著的累积效应，这一效应会影响特定栖息地投资的效率。

title: Slippage Effects of the Conservation Reserve Program
abstract: Given that the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) costs taxpayers $2 billion per year and remains the largest conservation program in U.S. history, Roberts and Bucholtz are to be commended for revisiting the slippage issue. However, their central point that regional variation in CRP acreage is endogenous is inconsistent with CRP implementation rules and data. Thus, it is not surprising that the null hypothesis of exogeneity cannot be rejected by statistical tests.
abstract_zh: 鉴于保护性休耕计划（CRP）每年耗费纳税人20亿美元，并且仍是美国历史上规模最大的保护计划，Roberts和Bucholtz重新审视溢出（slippage）问题的做法值得称赞。然而，他们的核心观点，即CRP面积的区域差异是内生的，与CRP的实施规则和数据并不相符。因此，统计检验无法拒绝外生性的原假设，也就不足为奇了。

title: The Choice of Tillage, Rotation, and Soil Testing Practices: Economic and Environmental Implications
abstract: Farmers' management practices can have a significant effect on agricultural pollution. Past research has analyzed factors influencing adoption of a single management practice. But often adoption decisions about many practices are made simultaneously, which suggests use of a polychotomous‐choice model to analyze decisions. Such a model is applied to the choice of alternative management practices on cropland in the Central Nebraska Basin and controlled for self‐selection and the interaction between alternative practices. The results of the choice model are used to estimate the economic and environmental effects of adopting alternative combinations of management practices.
abstract_zh: 农户的管理措施会对农业污染产生重大影响。以往研究大多分析影响单一管理措施采用的因素，但农户往往同时就多项措施作出决策，这提示应使用多元选择（polychotomous-choice）模型来分析这类决策。本文将此类模型应用于中内布拉斯加盆地耕地上替代性管理措施的选择，并控制了自选择以及各项替代措施之间的相互作用。选择模型的结果被用于估计采用不同管理措施组合所带来的经济和环境效应。

title: The Impact of Policies and Site Characteristics on Potential Groundwater Pollution in Wisconsin
abstract: In this paper we present an empirical framework for quantifying the extensive margin effects of commodity programs and chemical‐use taxes on potential groundwater pollution in Wisconsin. The approach emphasizes the role of the joint distribution of crops and site characteristics in determining policy impacts on groundwater contamination. The results indicate that for a given reduction in total polluting acreage an increase in the Acreage Reduction Program rate for corn is well targeted and would reduce high‐polluting acreage more than a chemical‐use tax or a target price policy in the areas where it might be needed most.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个实证框架，用于量化商品计划和化学品使用税对威斯康星州潜在地下水污染的外延边际效应。该方法强调，作物与地块特征的联合分布在决定政策对地下水污染影响方面的作用。结果表明，对于给定的污染农田总面积削减目标，提高玉米的减耕计划（Acreage Reduction Program）比率针对性更强，在最需要的地区，其减少高污染面积的效果优于化学品使用税或目标价格政策。
